main_body: open wooden coal bin with a heaped coal pile showing above the front rim; wood front face below
top_band: Reading down the middle column: dark coal heap (rows ~3-9) filling the opening, then a thin tan front rim (rows ~9-10), then the brown front face (rows 10-15). The side rims are tan slanted bands left and right.
evidence: The opening is a dark trapezoid with the side rims receding, and the coal heap is visible from above inside it (about rows 5-9). The front rim is a lighter 1-2 row line, followed by a darker row under it and then the front face. The front face has an inset lighter panel with a dark top edge. The back rim is hidden by the coal, so it reads as a bin seen from above and in front, not a rim-only or flat elevation. The top is marginal but acceptable.

style.evidence: The wood has about 4 steps (tan rim, mid brown, dark brown, deep brown) with tinted dark-brown outlines, which is good. The coal heap is a large near-flat dark mass with only 2-3 tones and a few scattered highlight pixels, which is a flat fill of 5x5 or more. The front panel is mostly one flat brown. Next to the roofed well and the stall, the piece has fewer steps, less grain and fewer colours per tile, so it looks thinner than the reference.
